title: Deprescribing proton pump inhibitors: evidence-based clinical practice guideline
authors: Farrell B, Pottie K, Thompson W, Boghossian T, Pizzola L, Rashid FJ, et al.
funder: Funding was provided by the Government of Ontario.
authorConflicts: Farrell received research funding to develop the guideline and payments for a guideline summary and speaking engagements; Moayyedi holds a chair partially funded by AstraZeneca and has received payments from AstraZeneca for speaking engagements; the other authors declared none.
result: For adults whose upper gastrointestinal symptoms resolved after at least 4 weeks of PPI treatment: decrease the daily dose, or stop and change to on-demand use (strong recommendation, low-quality evidence); alternatively consider an H2-receptor antagonist (weak, moderate quality). Not applicable to Barrett oesophagus, Los Angeles grade C or D oesophagitis or a history of bleeding gastrointestinal ulcers. Endorsed by the Canadian Association of Gastroenterology among others.
